query: What data sharing policy (public, restricted, aggregated) and anonymization/aggregation techniques will protect institutional privacy while enabling reproducible research?

response.query: What data sharing policy (public, restricted, aggregated) and anonymization/aggregation techniques will protect institutional privacy while enabling reproducible research?
response.answer: Restrict data sharing with aggregated and anonymized techniques, using differential privacy and pseudonymization to protect institutional privacy while enabling reproducible research.

results.title: [PDF] Reimagining Global Health through Artificial Intelligence
results.content: while ensuring privacy include data anonymization, aggregation de- identification, virtual cohorts, differential privacy, pseudonymization, federated.
